annotation.title_en: Basic Concepts for Ensuring Appropriateness of AI in Japan (Guidelines under Article 13 of the AI Promotion Act)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Government of Japan (Cabinet Office / AI Strategy Headquarters)
annotation.summary_en: Japan's December 2025 voluntary guidelines issued under Article 13 of the AI Promotion Act. They set basic principles and a policy for appropriate AI R&D and use, and assign duties to developers, business users, government and citizens. They stress risk-based, agile, stakeholder-engaged AI governance, transparency, safety and AI literacy. They contain no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Issued under Article 13 of Japan's AI Promotion Act (Act No. 53 of 2025) as non-binding guidance for all actors
Basic policy: risk-based measures, stakeholder involvement, end-to-end AI governance, agile PDCA response
Developers and business users should build AI governance, using ISO/IEC 42001 and the Hiroshima AI Process reporting framework
Governments should lead AI use, raise AI literacy, appoint AI governance officers and pursue international coordination
Citizens should use AI responsibly under human-centric principles and with AI literacy
